from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json
root = Path('products/services/liveca-invoice-pilot')
sources = [('homepage', 'https://www.liveca.ca/', 'a53ac266f23eb5c53c3b68480f41ccb2e11d00229af6f2dc4a10af9617477fbb', ['bookkeeping', 'accounts payable']), ('contact', 'https://www.liveca.ca/contact', '0d557c5233ef74b919a232fa5b6743358e86958391cf0dd120ce3a929654d8aa', ['What services interest you?', 'Current Accounting System?'])]
records = []
for name, url, expected_hash, phrases in sources:
    raw = (root / 'raw' / (name + '.html')).read_bytes()
    digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    text = raw.decode('utf-8')
    assert digest == expected_hash, name
    assert all(phrase in text for phrase in phrases), name
    records.append({'url': url, 'sha256': digest, 'literal_matches': phrases})
result = {'sources': records, 'workflow': 'LiveCA advertises bookkeeping and accounts payable services.', 'route_observation': 'The reviewed contact form asks prospective clients to specify the services they want and their accounting system.', 'disposition': 'Hold this route. The reviewed sources do not establish that the form accepts supplier inquiries.', 'reconsider_when': 'LiveCA publishes a vendor contact route or explicitly states that the existing form accepts supplier inquiries.', 'commercial_effect': 'No inquiry sent. Buying interest, acceptance and settlement remain unverified.'}
output = root / 'route-disposition.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
